description:
• Brand introduction: At The VapeZone, we're dedicated to bringing you the best in vaping technology and lifestyle products. Our mission is to provide an exceptional vaping experience with top-quality devices, flavorful e-liquids, and essential accessories. We pride ourselves on our extensive selection, competitive prices, and outstanding customer service. Whether you're new to vaping or a seasoned enthusiast, The VapeZone is your go-to destination for all things vape. Explore our wide range of products, stay ahead with the latest trends, and enjoy the ultimate vaping experience with The VapeZone.
• Product description: Welcome to The VapeZone, your premier destination for all things vaping. We pride ourselves on offering an extensive selection of high-quality vaping products, from the latest vape devices and accessories to a wide variety of e-liquids in flavors that will delight your senses. Our mission is to provide vapers with top-tier products that enhance their vaping experience, ensuring satisfaction with every puff. Whether you're a seasoned vaper or new to the scene, The VapeZone has everything you need to enjoy a premium vaping journey. Explore our collection today and discover why we're the go-to source for vaping enthusiasts everywhere.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): At The VapeZone, we go beyond the ordinary by offering a unique blend of high-quality vaping products and intimate wellness solutions. Our carefully curated selection caters to both your vaping needs and your desire for enhanced intimacy. With top-tier disposable vapes, a diverse range of flavors, and an exclusive AdultZone for couples, we provide a seamless shopping experience that prioritizes quality, variety, and customer satisfaction. Elevate your lifestyle with The VapeZone, where exceptional vaping meets intimate pleasure.
• Payment terms: 

Accepted Payment Methods:

  • Credit/Debit Cards: We accept major credit and debit cards, including Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover.
  • Bank Transfers: Direct bank transfers are available for larger orders. Please contact our customer service team for details.
  • Gift Cards: Use The VapeZone gift cards for a convenient checkout experience.

Payment Security:

  • All transactions are processed through secure payment gateways to ensure your personal and payment information is protected.
  • We use advanced encryption technology and adhere to strict industry standards to safeguard your data.

Billing:

  • Your credit/debit card will be charged at the time of purchase.
  • For bank transfers, orders will be processed once payment is received and confirmed.

Order Confirmation:

  • After placing an order, you will receive an email confirmation detailing your purchase and payment status.
  • Please ensure your contact information is accurate to receive timely updates.

Payment Issues:

  • If your payment is declined, please verify your payment details and try again.
  • For further assistance, contact our customer service team at customercare@thevape.zone or 072 303 0000.

Refunds and Returns:

  • Refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 7-10 business days after return confirmation.
  • For more information on returns and refunds, please refer to our Returns Policy page.

Contact Us:

  • For any payment-related inquiries, please reach out to our customer service team via email at customercare@thevape.zone or call us at 072 303 0000. We are available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Local Time).

Thank you for choosing The VapeZone. We are committed to providing you with a secure and convenient shopping experience.

Welcome to The VapeZone ! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: customercare@thevape.zone.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to customercare@thevape.zone for support.
